The color of an eggplant is purple.

**Beginning:** Ben, living on an isolated farm, unexpectedly discovers he possesses the unique ability to communicate with the local animal inhabitants. Through these conversations, he gains deep insight into their daily lives, fears, and struggles, which transforms his perspective and leads him to adopt the role of their champion.

**Climax:** An impending severe storm threatens to destroy the farm and endanger all the animals. Ben must act quickly, orchestrating a daring and complex plan that relies on his new communication skills to coordinate the animals and mitigate the disaster.

**Resolution:** Ben’s plan succeeds, resulting in the salvation of the farm and the safety of the animals. This victory cements his role as their protector and grants him a newfound sense of purpose and belonging.
